headlines.title: Union Pacific (UNP) Reaffirms Dividend, Where Does Fair Value Sit Now?
headlines.summary: Union Pacific (UNP) just reaffirmed its income stream for shareholders. The board declared a quarterly dividend of $1.42 per share, payable December 30, 2026, to investors of record on December 4. Union Pacific shares trade at $290.83, with the 1-day share price return of 0.67% coming after a softer 90-day share price move that declined 6.37%. The 1-year total shareholder return of 29.

headlines.title: Mega Rail Deal Gets Unusual WH Meeting
headlines.summary: In a highly unusual gathering, White House officials met privately with a group of hedge fund investors betting on whether the $72 billion tie-up between Union Pacific and Norfolk Southern will win approval from the Trump administration, according to people familiar with the matter. Bloomberg's Scarlet Fu reports on "Bloomberg Deals.

headlines.title: Seth Klarman, Dan Loeb and 7 Other Big Funds Sold Union Pacific Last Quarter, While 9 Bought. Who’s Right?
headlines.summary: Key TakeawaysNine big funds sold Union Pacific in the third quarter, including Viking Global, Seth Klarman’s Baupost Group and Dan Loeb’s Third Point, while nine bought, led by GQG Partners’ new $476 million stake. Some buyers bought other railroads too: Avala Global opened a CSX stake, and GQG opened one in Canadian Pacific Kansas City.

headlines.title: Union Pacific Corporation CEO Jim Vena and CFO Jennifer Hamann to Address the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference
headlines.summary: OMAHA, Neb., November 25, 2026--Jim Vena, chief executive officer, and Jennifer Hamann, executive vice president and chief financial officer, of Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE: UNP) will address the Goldman Sachs Industrials and Materials Conference on Wednesday, Dec. 2, 2026, at 10:10 a.m. ET.

headlines.title: J.B. Hunt Comes Out Against Union Pacific-Norfolk Southern Merger
headlines.summary: The trucking company says the deal would do more harm than benefit, disputing the railroads' claim that it would lead to 2.1 million truck-to-rail conversions.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
